player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Closet and Sunroom, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to produce the same graph with the same nodes and edges, which is not allowed. Next time, I will make sure to update the graph correctly after each move. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also pay attention to the edges and nodes in the graph and update them accordingly. For example, if I move from Closet to Sunroom, I will add the edge ("Closet", "Sunroom") to the graph.
